entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Student
entries.en: A calling card?

entries.speaker: Excited Male Student
entries.en: I heard it was already posted by the time[n]everyone got here this morning.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sir Suguru Kamoshida, the utter bastard[n]of lust...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We know how shitty you are, and that[n]you put your twisted desires on students[n]that can't fight back.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's why we have decided to steal away[n]those desires and make you confess your[n]sins.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This will be done tomorrow, so we hope[n]you will be ready. From, the Phantom[n]Thieves of Hearts.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Wow.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not bad, eh?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I looked up a bunch of similar stuff[n]online for reference.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um... Yeah...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I know what you wanted to say, but[n]it sounded like an idiot trying to be[n]an adult.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Your logo's a little lacking, too.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Okay, y'know what? Th-That ain't true!

entries.speaker: Shy Female Student
entries.en: Did Mr. Kamoshida do something wrong?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Female Student
entries.en: Does this mean the rumors are true!?

entries.speaker: Rumor-Loving Student
entries.en: Wait a sec... Is someone gonna take[n]something from Mr. Kamoshida?

entries.speaker: Excited Male Student
entries.en: What's with this weird logo?

entries.speaker: Excited Male Student
entries.en: And who're these Phantom Thieves of[n]Hearts people?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...It got everyone excited, so it's all good,[n]yeah?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Who's responsible for this!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Look at that. A predictable reaction for[n]someone who knows what we mean by[n]distorted desires.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I think it's hittin' him pretty hard.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Did you do this!? Or was it you!?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: ...Was it you two!?
What're you talking about?
What if it was?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: So, you're playing dumb?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: What garbage...

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Eh, it's not a problem. You'll be expelled[n]soon enough anyway.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Come... Steal it, if you can!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Judging from Kamoshida's response...[n]I'm sure we had an effect on his Palace!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Does that mean the Treasure's appeared!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll be able to get it today, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's not just "today." It's ONLY today.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The impact of seeing a calling card doesn't[n]last long, and it cannot be repeated.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This will be our one chance to steal the[n]Treasure.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: One day's more than enough for us!
The calling card has been delivered to[n]the target.
You can now enter their Palace and steal[n]the Treasure within.
